Investigator qualitative synthesis: The physical audit provides direct, ground-truth evidence that the ledger overstates usable stock by exactly 50 units (5321 ledger vs 5271 physical). This is a confirmed internal record-keeping discrepancy with no ambiguity. In contrast, H2 and H3 rely on generic market signals (NORMAL_MARKET status, 2 shortage records) and empirical priors rather than facility-specific evidence. The healthy trust cover of ~88 days and zero shortfall units indicate no active supply disruption impacting this facility. The 2 active world-model conflicts likely relate to the ledger-physical mismatch and the generic shortage flag, but only the former is quantified and verified at this site. Therefore, phantom stock drift (H1) is the only hypothesis directly substantiated by the observed data.
